title: DIFFormer: Scalable (Graph) Transformers Induced by Energy Constrained Diffusion
selection_reason: DIFFormer provides a linear-complexity graph-transformer encoder for prohibitive instance counts. The abstract supplies a concrete scaling property in attention-based encoders that can transfer to large-model sequence systems.
